stories.h: Manchester United sack Michael Carrick; Pochettino reportedly agrees to take over
stories.p: Manchester United have sacked head coach Michael Carrick after just one Premier League win in 10 games left them in the relegation zone. Mauricio Pochettino has reportedly agreed to replace him.
body: Manchester United have sacked head coach Michael Carrick following a poor start to the Premier League season.
## Why he was sacked

United have won only one of their first 10 league matches, against Ipswich Town in August, leaving them in the relegation zone. Their other wins this season came in the Champions League. According to reports on Thursday, 12 November 2026, club executives met co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe in Monaco to finalise the decision. Carrick and his backroom staff are reportedly set to receive about £5 million in compensation.
## Pochettino to take charge

Reports say the club lined up a replacement before ending Carrick's tenure, approaching US Soccer about releasing Mauricio Pochettino from his contract as head coach of the United States men's team. The former Tottenham and Chelsea manager is said to have agreed to take charge at Old Trafford. Releasing him from his US contract is reported to cost about £7 million.
## Background

Carrick,, a former United midfielder, first stepped in after the dismissal of Ruben Amorim last season and did well enough to earn a permanent two-year contract in May, having guided the club into the Champions League. His first full season in charge has fallen well short of that early promise.
## What happens next
United have not yet officially confirmed Pochettino's appointment.
more: United have one league win in 10 games.

stories.h: Speed Darlington apologises to Burna Boy, begs him to drop court charges
stories.p: Singer Speed Darlington has publicly apologised to Burna Boy and asked him to withdraw the legal charges against him, promising never to insult or mention him again.
body: Singer Speed Darlington has made a public apology to Burna Boy, appealing to the Grammy-winning star to withdraw the court charges filed against him.
## What he said

In a video posted on Instagram on Thursday, 12 November 2026, Speed Darlington, whose real name is Darlington Okoye, admitted that his words may have caused Burna Boy pain and embarrassment. He said he had wrongly assumed that other people shared his own temperament and tolerance, and pledged to stop all comments about the singer, direct or indirect, if the charges are withdrawn. He also promised to stop mentioning Burna Boy's name altogether once the matter is settled.
## How the feud began

The dispute escalated in October 2024, when Speed Darlington posted videos questioning Burna Boy's Grammy win for his album 'Twice as Tall' and making disparaging remarks about him. The matter later became a legal case, with Speed Darlington facing charges filed after a complaint from Burna Boy's camp.
## How people reacted
The apology drew a wave of reactions online, with many users surprised by Speed Darlington's change of tone. Burna Boy had not publicly responded at the time of writing.
more: Speed Darlington asked Burna Boy to drop the charges.

stories.h: Crowd chants 'Obi' as Deputy Speaker Kalu campaigns for Tinubu at Abia festival
stories.p: A crowd at a cultural festival in Bende, Abia State, reportedly drowned out Deputy Speaker Benjamin Kalu with chants of 'Obi, Obi' as he tried to rally support for President Tinubu's re-election.
body: Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives Benjamin Kalu was reportedly met with chants of Peter Obi's name as he campaigned for President Bola Tinubu at a festival in Abia State.
## What happened

Kalu, an All Progressives Congress (APC) lawmaker who represents Bende Federal Constituency, was addressing the Item Okpi Festival, an annual cultural celebration in Bende Local Government Area, on Saturday. According to reports on Thursday, 12 November 2026, the audience responded with loud and sustained chants of Obi's name rather than applause. When a woman on stage began a pro-Obi song, Kalu reportedly asked her to switch to a pro-Tinubu song, but the chanting continued. The Deputy Speaker was said to have remarked in Igbo that the crowd did not seem to want a university the President plans to build for them, and suggested some of those chanting were not from Item.
## Background

Abia is governed by Alex Otti of the Labour Party, a former ally of Obi who has said he supports Tinubu as the sitting president while acknowledging that his party has its own candidate. Obi, now the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), remains popular in the South-East, where the APC is working hard to win support ahead of the 16 January 2027 election. Kalu has not publicly commented on the video.

stories.h: NDC deputy national spokesman Abdulmumin Abdulsalami quits party
stories.p: Abdulmumin Abdulsalami, deputy national publicity secretary of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, has resigned from the party, saying a few powerful officials sidelined him. He says he is stepping back from politics.
body: The deputy national publicity secretary of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Abdulmumin Abdulsalami, has resigned from the party.
## His reasons

In a resignation letter addressed to NDC national chairman Senator Moses Cleopas and reported on Thursday, 12 November 2026, Abdulsalami said he was a foundation member who played a central role in the party's early growth, but that his efforts had clashed with the interests of a few powerful officials. He said the decision was about his peace of mind, citing what he described as repeated injustices against him. He declined to name the officials he blamed.
## What next

Abdulsalami said he was stepping away from partisan politics entirely. A party source quoted in reports claimed he had not been paid a salary or given a working budget since the party was formed, and that the NDC's national leader, Senator Seriake Dickson, had persuaded him to stay on several occasions since October.
## Background

Abdulsalami was previously the NDC's interim chairman in Kogi State. The NDC is the party of presidential candidate Peter Obi and his running mate, Rabiu Kwankwaso. His exit comes a day after Obi's former spokesman Yunusa Tanko took a senior role in the SDP's presidential campaign. The party had not publicly responded to his resignation at the time of writing.
more: Abdulsalami says he was sidelined.

stories.h: Nollywood actor Justin UG joins the US Air Force
stories.p: Actor and content creator Justin UG has graduated from training and joined the United States Air Force, sharing photos from his graduation and saying the experience tested him like nothing before.
body: Nigerian actor and content creator Justin Chukwudi Ugonna, popularly known as Justin UG, has joined the United States Air Force.
## What he shared

In an Instagram post on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the entertainer shared photos and videos from his military graduation ceremony, showing him in uniform alongside fellow graduates. He said he had never imagined himself pursuing a military career, and described the training as physically and mentally demanding, saying it had tested him in ways he had never experienced. He said the experience showed him how much the human mind can endure.

stories.h: Tacha secures physical headquarters for her make-up brand
stories.p: Former BBNaija housemate Tacha Akide has announced that she has secured a physical headquarters for her make-up brand, Tacha Beauty HQ, and has invited interior designers to help transform the space.
body: Former Big Brother Naija housemate Tacha Akide has announced a new milestone for her make-up business.
## What she announced

In posts shared on her social media pages and reported on Thursday, 12 November 2026, Tacha said she had secured a physical headquarters for her brand, Tacha Beauty HQ, and thanked God for the achievement. She did not reveal the location but shared a glimpse of the property and called on interior designers to help turn it into a beautiful and functional space.
## How people reacted
Fans and well-wishers flooded her comments with congratulatory messages, praising her business growth.
## Background
Tacha rose to fame on the fourth season of Big Brother Naija in 2019.

stories.h: EU raises alarm over election violence and hate speech ahead of 2027 polls
stories.p: The European Union's ambassador to Nigeria, Gautier Mignot, has warned that rising election-related violence, hate speech and intimidation threaten democratic progress and could discourage Nigerians from voting in 2027.
body: The European Union has expressed concern about rising election-related violence, hate speech and political intimidation in Nigeria ahead of the 2027 general elections.
## What the EU said

Speaking at the opening of the 2026 Civil Society and Human Rights Defenders Forum in Abuja, reported on Thursday, 12 November 2026, the EU Ambassador to Nigeria and ECOWAS, Gautier Mignot, warned that such incidents erode democratic gains and discourage citizens from taking full part in elections. He said free civic and political space allows civil society groups and citizens to monitor how elections are run, track campaign promises and hold leaders to account, and helps prevent authorities from manipulating the rules.
## Support for institutions

Mignot said open public debate, independent media, peaceful assembly and an active civil society are vital to credible elections. He said the EU would continue to support Nigerian institutions, including the National Human Rights Commission, to help create a free and fair electoral environment, while stressing that it would not interfere in domestic politics.
## Background

The warning follows a string of violent incidents linked to campaigns in several states. Peter Obi's convoy was attacked in Calabar, NDC supporters' vehicles were destroyed at a rally in Delta, and APC supporters were attacked ahead of a rally in Katsina. The Inspector-General of Police has also warned officers against being used by politicians. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: The EU says violence and hate speech threaten the polls.
It pledged support for Nigerian institutions.

stories.h: IGP Disu warns officers: 'Do not be used' by politicians in 2027 elections
stories.p: Inspector-General of Police Tunji Disu has warned officers that anyone who colludes with politicians, facilitates thuggery or interferes with voters will be disciplined, and has ordered senior officers to stay in their commands until the elections are over.
body: The Inspector-General of Police, Tunji Disu, has warned police officers against allowing politicians to use them to undermine the 2027 elections.
## What he said

Speaking on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, at a monthly meeting with senior officers in Abuja, Disu said the police would remain neutral and give equal protection to all candidates, parties, supporters and voters. He said he would not tolerate any officer using police authority to advance the interests of a party, candidate or sponsor, and that officers found colluding with politicians, aiding thuggery or interfering with voters' rights would be disciplined. He told officers that the force is not a tool for any politician and urged them not to allow themselves to be used.
## Officers to stay at posts
The IGP directed commissioners of police and other senior officers to remain in their commands throughout the electoral process.
## Background

The warning comes amid concern over political violence ahead of the elections and a recent controversy over a video showing police officers escorting businessman Blord, which the police said was unlawful. On the same day, the police said they had raided so-called phone farms used to spread election misinformation. The European Union has also raised concerns about violence and hate speech before the polls.

stories.h: DSS intercepts weapons smuggled on camels from Niger Republic into Sokoto
stories.p: The DSS has reportedly intercepted a consignment of weapons, including 21 AK-47 rifles, four machine guns and 825 magazines, allegedly being smuggled on camels from Niger Republic to bandits in north-west Nigeria.
body: The Department of State Services (DSS) has intercepted a large consignment of weapons and ammunition allegedly being smuggled from Niger Republic to armed bandits in north-west Nigeria.
## What was seized

According to security sources quoted in reports on Thursday, 12 November 2026, the interception took place on Tuesday, 10 November, at Dawakawa in Goronyo Local Government Area of Sokoto State. Operatives reportedly recovered 21 AK-47 rifles, four PKT machine guns and 825 magazines. The suspected smugglers were said to have been using camels to move the weapons along remote routes to avoid detection.
## Why it matters

Security analysts described the seizure as a significant blow to an alleged cross-border arms supply network that is suspected of arming bandit groups in the North-West. The use of camels shows how criminal networks are using unconventional methods to move weapons across the long, porous border with Niger. Some reports described the operation as foiling a major terror plot.
## Arrests
It is not clear whether any suspects were arrested.
more: 21 AK-47 rifles and four machine guns were seized.
The weapons were allegedly moved on camels.
The seizure was in Goronyo, Sokoto State.

stories.h: Cooking gas now up to ₦1,800 per kg in Lagos, Ogun and Oyo
stories.p: Retail cooking gas prices have reportedly jumped from about ₦1,200 to ₦1,800 per kilogramme in parts of Lagos, Ogun and Oyo within a month, after depot prices rose by nearly 32 per cent. Some households say they are turning to charcoal.
body: Households in Lagos, Ogun and Oyo states are paying much more for cooking gas after a sharp rise in prices over the past month.
## The new prices

According to reports on Thursday, 12 November 2026, retail prices of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) at several outlets rose from around ₦1,200 to ₦1,800 per kilogramme. In parts of Ogun State, including Magboro, Mowe and Ibafo, some residents said they were paying as much as ₦1,900 per kg. In Oyo State, prices reportedly range from about ₦1,450 per kg at direct outlets to between ₦1,500 and ₦1,650 at neighbourhood retailers.
## Why prices rose
The increase follows a reported 31.8 per cent rise in depot prices, from ₦1,100 to ₦1,450 per kg, which has pushed up costs along the supply chain.
## Impact on households
Some households say they are considering returning to charcoal because they can no longer afford gas.
## Background
The latest increase comes even as petrol prices have eased slightly, with Dangote Refinery reportedly cutting its petrol price this week.
more: Retail prices reportedly hit ₦1,800 per kg.

stories.h: IK Ogbonna and friends remember Alexx Ekubo six months after his death
stories.p: Actor IK Ogbonna, businessman Vintage Luxury and the late actor's sister have shared emotional tributes to Alexx Ekubo, six months after he died of kidney cancer at the age of 40.
body: Friends and family of the late Nollywood actor Alexx Ekubo have shared emotional tributes to mark six months since his death.
## The tributes

On Thursday, 12 November 2026, actor IK Ogbonna, widely regarded as Ekubo's closest friend, posted a throwback video of the two of them on Instagram with a simple heart emoji, saying in a separate post that six months still felt like yesterday. Businessman Vintage Luxury also shared a tribute describing his late friend as rare, while Ekubo's sister posted a message saying she missed him more than life.
## His death

Alexx Ekubo died on Monday, 11 May 2026, at a hospital in Lagos after complications from advanced kidney cancer. He was 40. His death shocked Nollywood, and tributes poured in from colleagues, fans and public figures. He was buried on 18 June 2026 in Arochukwu, Abia State, in a ceremony attended by many figures from the entertainment industry.
## Background
Ekubo was one of Nollywood's best-known leading men and was known for his close friendship with IK Ogbonna.
more: Ekubo died on 11 May 2026 aged 40.
IK Ogbonna shared a throwback video.
His sister and friends also posted tributes.

stories.h: Biden says he would not have sought re-election had he known he had cancer
stories.p: Former US President Joe Biden says he would not have run for a second term if he had known about his cancer, and has played down the importance of the 2024 debate that led to his exit from the race.
body: Former US President Joe Biden says he would not have run for a second term if he had known he had cancer.
## What he said

In an interview ahead of the release of his memoir, 'Promise Me, America', reported on Thursday, 12 November 2026, Biden said he had felt unwell before his diagnosis but did not know he was ill while he was campaigning. He also played down his June 2024 debate against Donald Trump, saying everyone makes mistakes in debates and that, in his view, it was not very consequential. He said he had expected there to be another debate.
## Background

Biden's poor debate performance triggered intense pressure from fellow Democrats and led him to withdraw from the 2024 race and endorse Vice-President Kamala Harris, 107 days before the election. Harris went on to lose to Trump. About four months after leaving the White House, Biden was diagnosed with an aggressive form of prostate cancer.
more: Biden says he would not have run had he known.
He says the 2024 debate was not consequential.
His memoir is due out soon.

stories.h: Court remands journalist Daniel Ojukwu in Abuja prison over cybercrime charges
stories.p: Investigative journalist Daniel Ojukwu has been remanded in prison in Abuja on a 12-count cybercrime charge linked to his reports about a presidential aide, pending a bail hearing. The decision has renewed concerns about press freedom.
body: A court in Abuja has ordered that investigative journalist Daniel Ojukwu be held in prison pending a hearing on his bail application.
## The charges

Ojukwu, who works for the Foundation for Investigative Journalism, was arraigned on a 12-count charge of allegedly breaching Nigeria's Cybercrimes Act, and the court ordered his remand on Tuesday, 10 November 2026. The charges relate to reports he published about Adejoke Orelope-Adefulire, who was senior special assistant on the Sustainable Development Goals under former President Muhammadu Buhari and now holds the same role under President Bola Tinubu. The charges have not been tested at trial.
## Press freedom concerns

The decision drew widespread criticism from media freedom advocates, who have long argued that the cybercrimes law is used to silence journalists. According to the Committee to Protect Journalists, at least 29 journalists have been prosecuted under the law since it was enacted in 2015. Nigeria is ranked 112th out of 180 countries in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index compiled by Reporters Without Borders.
## Background
Ojukwu was previously detained by police for several days in 2024 over a report on the same official, a case that also drew national and international criticism.
more: Ojukwu faces a 12-count cybercrime charge.
He is held pending a bail hearing.
Press freedom groups have criticised the remand.

stories.h: Indonesia's vice-president Gibran resigns after court voids his school certificate
stories.p: Indonesian Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has reportedly handed his resignation to President Prabowo Subianto, after the Supreme Court ruled that a high-school equivalence certificate he used to qualify for office was invalid.
body: Indonesia's Vice-President, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, has resigned, according to an aide who said the letter was handed directly to President Prabowo Subianto on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. It was not immediately clear whether the President had accepted it.
## The court ruling

The resignation follows a ruling by Indonesia's Supreme Court that declared invalid a high-school equivalence certificate Gibran used during the 2024 election campaign. Indonesian law requires anyone running for vice-president to have completed senior high school. Gibran, who studied in Singapore and Australia, had relied on a local equivalence document and argued that his university education was enough proof. The court reportedly found no evidence of a foreign qualification that could legally replace a senior high school certificate, and pointed to an earlier Constitutional Court ruling that reached the same conclusion. On Tuesday he had asked for a chance to challenge the ruling.
## Political pressure
The ruling prompted swift political action, with more than 100 lawmakers reportedly backing moves against him.
## Background
Gibran is the eldest son of former President Joko Widodo.
more: Gibran handed his letter to President Prabowo.
A court voided his school equivalence certificate.

stories.h: Oyedepo says there are 'plenty of fakes' among Nigerian pastors
stories.p: Bishop David Oyedepo has sparked debate after a video showed him lamenting the number of fake ministers in Nigeria, saying the problem is alarming and that true believers want to be counted as people of faith.
body: Bishop David Oyedepo, founder of Living Faith Church Worldwide, has drawn wide reactions online after a video showed him criticising fake pastors in Nigeria.
## What he said

In the clip, which spread on social media on Thursday, 12 November 2026, the cleric was addressing a gathering that included several dignitaries. He said the number of fraudulent ministers in the country was alarming and that genuine Christians want to be counted as people of faith. He also reflected on his own ministry, which he said spans nearly 50 years. The occasion appeared to be a formal church celebration, but his comments on fake pastors became the main talking point.
## How people reacted
The comments drew mixed reactions on social media.
## Background

Oyedepo is one of Nigeria's most influential church leaders, and his comments regularly spark debate. Last week he warned politicians that the evil they fail to stop will eventually stop them, and told anyone with plans to Islamise Nigeria to drop them.
more: Oyedepo called the number of fake pastors alarming.

stories.h: APC-branded ₦200 recharge cards reportedly handed out at Tinubu's Rivers rally spark debate
stories.p: Photos of ₦200 recharge cards bearing APC branding, reportedly distributed at President Tinubu's campaign rally in Rivers State, have drawn mockery and debate online about campaign giveaways.
body: Images of recharge cards bearing the logo of the All Progressives Congress (APC), reportedly handed out at President Bola Tinubu's campaign rally in Rivers State, have sparked debate on social media.
## What happened

A man who came across pictures of the ₦200 airtime cards questioned online what anyone could achieve with such a small amount, and his comment, shared on Thursday, 12 November 2026, quickly drew reactions. The cards were said to have circulated among people who attended the rally.
## How people reacted

Some users mocked the giveaway and said the money would be better spent on fixing the country, while others joked about how the airtime might be used. Some warned that small gifts like this could still influence some voters.
## Background

Campaign giveaways have become a talking point ahead of the 2027 elections. The African Democratic Congress (ADC) recently accused the APC of handing out cash and gifts at campaign events and called on the anti-graft agency and INEC to investigate. The APC had not publicly responded to the recharge card images at the time of writing. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: The cards were reportedly worth ₦200 each.
They bore APC branding.
Reactions online were mostly mocking.

stories.h: Wumi Toriola confronts content creator who kept filming as she fixed her outfit
stories.p: Actress Wumi Toriola reportedly confronted a content creator who kept recording while she adjusted her skirt on the red carpet at a Lagos film premiere. The creator was heard apologising, and the video has sparked debate about camera etiquette.
body: Nollywood actress Wumi Toriola has sparked conversation online after confronting a content creator at a film premiere in Lagos.
## What happened

The incident took place on Sunday, 8 November 2026, at the premiere of the film 'Five Figurines'. While posing for photos on the red carpet, the actress noticed that her skirt had shifted and stopped to adjust it, apparently expecting those filming to pause. A content creator reportedly kept recording, and Toriola responded with a sarcastic remark about where the camera was pointed. The content creator could be heard apologising.
## How people reacted

The video went viral this week. Many users backed the actress, saying the person filming should have stopped, while others joked about her well-known outspokenness. The clip has prompted wider debate about privacy and the limits content creators should respect when filming celebrities at public events.
more: The incident happened at a Lagos premiere.

stories.h: FG reopens free CAC business registration for 250,000 small businesses
stories.p: The federal government has reopened its free business name registration programme through SMEDAN, targeting 250,000 nano, micro and small businesses, after earlier problems with the application portal.
body: The federal government has reopened its programme offering free registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) to small business owners.
## The programme

The scheme, run through the Small and Medium Enterprises Development Agency of Nigeria (SMEDAN), targets 250,000 nano, micro and small enterprises across the country, according to reports on Thursday, 12 November 2026. It covers the cost of business name registration, which is one of the barriers that keeps many small businesses informal.
## Who can apply

The programme is aimed at owners of small businesses not yet registered with the CAC, including traders, artisans, retailers and service providers. Business owners already registered with SMEDAN but not with the CAC may also qualify, subject to the agency's requirements.
## Why it reopened
The portal was reopened after applicants earlier reported difficulties accessing it, which disrupted the application process.
## Background
The reopening comes as the government also rolls out a ₦50,000 cash grant to vulnerable households.
more: 250,000 small businesses are targeted.
Registration is free through SMEDAN.
The portal reopened after earlier glitches.

stories.h: Former Obidient coordinator Yunusa Tanko joins SDP, to lead Adebayo's campaign
stories.p: Yunusa Tanko, once Peter Obi's spokesman and national coordinator of the Obidient Movement, has been named national coordinator of the SDP presidential campaign council for candidate Adewole Adebayo. He says he informed Obi before accepting.
body: Yunusa Tanko, a former spokesman for Peter Obi and ex-national coordinator of the Obidient Movement, has joined the Social Democratic Party (SDP) campaign for the 2027 presidential election.
## The new role

At the inauguration of the SDP Presidential Campaign Council in Abuja on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Tanko was named its national coordinator. In his acceptance speech he thanked the party's leadership and pledged full commitment to its presidential candidate, Prince Adewole Adebayo. He said he had reached out to both Obi and Senator Seriake Dickson, national leader of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), before taking up the post, and described his relationship with Adebayo as dating back to the 2023 election cycle.
## How he left Obi's camp

Tanko was removed as national coordinator of the Obidient Movement in October 2026 and briefly served as Obi's political adviser for Northern Nigeria. He resigned from that role on 30 October, saying he was returning to the National Consultative Front, which he co-chairs with Professor Pat Utomi. He took on that position in October after the death of former House of Representatives Speaker Ghali Na'Abba, who had co-chaired the group.
## Background

Obi, the 2023 Labour Party candidate, is now the NDC presidential candidate with Rabiu Kwankwaso as his running mate. Adebayo was also the SDP's presidential candidate in 2023. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027. Obi's campaign had not publicly reacted to Tanko's new role at the time of writing.
more: Tanko will coordinate the SDP presidential campaign.
He says he told Obi before accepting.
He was removed as Obidient coordinator in October.

stories.h: ADC accuses Kaduna government of sealing Arewa House to block Atiku meeting
stories.p: The ADC says the Kaduna State government sealed Arewa House to stop Atiku Abubakar from holding a consultation with Northern stakeholders there on Thursday. The party blamed President Tinubu and the APC.
body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has accused the Kaduna State government of sealing Arewa House to prevent its presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, from meeting Northern stakeholders there.
## What the ADC said

In a statement on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, issued by Phrank Shaibu, director of strategic communication for the ADC presidential campaign council, the party said Atiku's team had chosen Arewa House in Kaduna as the venue for a consultation on Thursday, 13 November, but that the state government sealed the building beforehand. Atiku himself said his campaign had proposed the venue and that the government sealed it the same day.
## The party's complaint

The ADC described Arewa House as part of the shared heritage of Northern Nigeria and said using it to block a political gathering was an insult to the region. It held President Bola Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress (APC) responsible, saying a ruling party must not use government power to block opposition activities. There was no immediate public response from the Kaduna State government, which is led by the APC, to the allegation.
## Background

Arewa House, the former residence of Sir Ahmadu Bello, the late Premier of the Northern Region, is a historic institution in Kaduna. Atiku is contesting the 2027 presidential election despite a court ruling that voided his nomination, which the ADC has appealed.
more: The ADC says Arewa House was sealed.
Atiku had planned a consultation there on Thursday.
Kaduna's government had not responded.

stories.h: Video of APC campaign bus stuck on bad road at Alaba Market goes viral
stories.p: A video showing an APC campaign bus trapped on a badly damaged, waterlogged road at Alaba Market in Lagos has gone viral, with onlookers mocking its occupants and criticising the state of the road.
body: A video of a campaign bus belonging to the All Progressives Congress (APC) stuck on a badly damaged road in Lagos has spread widely online.
## What the video shows

The clip, shared on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, shows a minibus bearing APC logos and candidates' portraits trapped on a waterlogged, broken stretch of road at Alaba Market. People on board try to push the vehicle free, while bystanders jeer and refuse to help, using the moment to complain about the state of local infrastructure and criticise the ruling party.
## Reactions

The video drew many comments online. Economist and politician Professor Pat Utomi joked that the bus driver needed only 'renewed hope' to endure the road, a reference to the slogan of President Bola Tinubu's government.
## Background
A similar video of an APC campaign bus stuck on a bad road in Ebonyi State circulated about a month ago.
more: The bus got stuck on a waterlogged road at Alaba Market.
Bystanders mocked its occupants.
A similar incident happened in Ebonyi last month.

stories.h: Oyo Assembly suspends four council chairmen, a day after three defected to APC
stories.p: The Oyo State House of Assembly has suspended four local government chairmen over alleged corruption and mismanagement of council funds. Three of them had defected from the APM to the APC a day earlier.
body: The Oyo State House of Assembly has suspended four local government chairmen over alleged corruption and mismanagement of council funds.
## What happened

The assembly announced the suspensions on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, citing corruption and financial misconduct, but did not immediately release details of the allegations against each chairman. The allegations have not been tested and the chairmen had not publicly responded at the time of writing.
## The defections

The timing has drawn attention because three of the four chairmen reportedly defected from the Allied Peoples Movement (APM) to the All Progressives Congress (APC) the day before. The fourth, the chairman of Iwajowa Local Government Area, Muritala Abiodun Oyewumi, was said to have remained in the APM.
## Background
Oyo State has 33 local government areas, and lawmakers have recently called for greater accountability in how council funds are managed.
more: Four council chairmen were suspended.

The assembly cited alleged corruption.

stories.h: Russia's ambassador to the US, Alexander Darchiev, dies at 66
stories.p: Alexander Darchiev, Russia's ambassador to the United States since early 2025, has died in Moscow at the age of 66 from an unspecified chronic illness, the Russian Foreign Ministry says.
body: Alexander Darchiev, Russia's ambassador to the United States, has died at the age of 66.
## What happened

The Russian Foreign Ministry announced his death on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said he died in Moscow from an unspecified chronic illness. The ministry praised him as an outstanding diplomat and an expert on the United States, and said details of a memorial service would be released later.
## His career

Darchiev became ambassador in Washington in early 2025, succeeding Anatoly Antonov. Before that, he headed the Foreign Ministry's North America department, served as Russia's ambassador to Canada and worked as a senior diplomat at the embassy in Washington. In February 2025, he led Russia's delegation at talks with the United States in Istanbul.
## Background
In 2017, Russia's UN envoy Vitaly Churkin also died suddenly in New York.
more: Darchiev died in Moscow at 66.
He had been ambassador since early 2025.
He led talks with the US in Istanbul.

stories.h: APC campaign council reportedly sacks spokespersons after embarrassing 112 emergency number incident on live TV
stories.p: The APC Presidential Campaign Council has reportedly removed its spokespersons after APC official Alwan Hassan's attempt to demonstrate the 112 emergency number on live television failed twice. Only three officials are now authorised to speak for the council.
body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council has reportedly removed some of its spokespersons following the controversy over a failed attempt to demonstrate Nigeria's 112 emergency number on live television.
## Only three can now speak
According to reports, President Bola Tinubu's Chief of Staff, Femi Gbajabiamila, announced on Wednesday that the spokespersons earlier named by the campaign council had been removed.

He said only three officials are now authorised to speak on behalf of the council: Senator Abdulaziz Yari, the Director General; Minister of Solid Minerals Dele Alake; and Minister of Information Mohammed Idris.
## What happened on live TV
It all started on Tuesday, when APC official Alwan Hassan appeared as a guest on a live television politics programme.

While discussing the achievements of the APC-led government, Hassan pointed to the 112 emergency number as an example of a working public service. He explained that Nigerians could dial it whenever they needed urgent help, whether in a medical emergency, a security threat or a road accident.
To prove his point, he challenged the host to dial 112 right there in the studio.
That was where things took an unexpected turn. The host tried the number, but the call failed to connect. He tried again, with the same result.
Hassan insisted the line was working and suggested network problems might have stopped the calls going through. His explanation did little to stop the criticism that followed.
## The backlash

Clips of the interview spread quickly online, with Nigerians questioning the reliability of a service people are meant to depend on in life-threatening situations. Opposition figures also seized on the incident to challenge the government's claims about improved public services.
## The real question
Is removing spokespersons really the answer, or should the government be more concerned about finding out why the emergency calls failed?
Someone calling 112 during an armed robbery, a serious accident or a medical emergency may not have the luxury of trying again and again until the network connects.

One failed demonstration does not prove the whole emergency system is broken. But it raises questions that deserve proper answers, and for many Nigerians, those answers matter far more than who is allowed to speak for a political campaign.
## Over to you
Was removing the spokespersons necessary, or should the priority be investigating and improving the 112 emergency response system?
more: The 112 emergency call failed twice on live TV.
Only Yari, Alake and Idris can now speak for the council.
Nigerians are questioning the reliability of the 112 line.

stories.h: Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso visit Yelewata community in Benue State, offer support to vulnerable children
stories.p: Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso have visited Yelewata in Benue State, where Obi laid a wreath at the memorial to victims of the community's deadly 2025 attack. The two leaders donated ₦10 million for vulnerable children and promised a motorised borehole.
body: Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso have visited Yelewata community in Benue State, bringing some hope to residents who have endured years of hardship and neglect.
## A moment of remembrance

Yelewata was the scene of a deadly attack in June 2025 that left many residents dead and shocked the nation. During the visit, Obi knelt to lay a wreath at the memorial bearing the names of the victims, as a large crowd looked on.
## Donations and promises

The two political leaders promised to provide a motorised borehole to help address the community's water needs. They also donated ₦10 million to support vulnerable children, while Professor Shija contributed another ₦2 million towards the education of orphans.
## The people speak
Beyond the donations, the people of Yelewata had their own stories to tell. They spoke about years of neglect, the difficulties they face every day and the lack of meaningful government support.

Imagine living for years without some of the basic things that should make life easier, while those elected to serve appear distant from your suffering. For residents, the visit was a chance to make their voices heard and draw attention to their situation.
## Action, not just visits
Promises must be followed by action. The community needs lasting solutions, not just occasional visits.
Leadership should be about compassion, listening to the people and doing something practical to improve their lives.
## Over to you
What do you think of this visit by Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso to Yelewata?
more: Obi laid a wreath at the Yelewata memorial.
Obi and Kwankwaso donated ₦10 million for vulnerable children.
They promised a motorised borehole for the community.

stories.h: Nigerian-born lawyer Shirley Emehelu becomes New Jersey's lieutenant governor
stories.p: Nigerian-born lawyer Shirley Emehelu has been appointed lieutenant governor of the US state of New Jersey, becoming the first immigrant to hold the post. She will also serve as Secretary of State.
body: Shirley U. Emehelu, a lawyer born in Nigeria, has been appointed lieutenant governor of New Jersey in the United States.
## The appointment

New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill appointed Emehelu on Monday, 9 November 2026, making her the state's fifth lieutenant governor and the first immigrant to hold the office. She was sworn in at the Statehouse in Trenton by the state's Chief Justice, Stuart Rabner. The appointment also means that, for the first time in New Jersey's history, women hold the state's two highest executive offices at the same time. Emehelu will also serve as Secretary of State, a role that covers government administration and oversight of elections.
## Why she was chosen

Sherrill described Emehelu as an experienced public servant and pointed to her record prosecuting financial crimes, protecting consumers, defending civil rights and tackling government waste. The governor also praised her leadership as acting Secretary of State, including overseeing the state's recent elections.
## Her Nigerian roots

Emehelu, who moved from Nigeria to the United States as a child, said she was proud of what the appointment means for Black women, immigrants and people who share her Nigerian heritage, and expressed hope that it would inspire young people to serve. She said she would work with the governor on the cost of living and economic opportunity.
more: Emehelu is the first immigrant to hold the post.
She will also serve as Secretary of State.
She moved from Nigeria to the US as a child.

stories.h: Police say they raided 'phone farms' used to sway online debate ahead of 2027 polls
stories.p: The police say they have raided so-called phone farms allegedly used to manipulate online discussion before the 2027 elections, and have arrested a suspect accused of spreading false reports about a South-South candidate.
body: The Nigeria Police Force says it has raided facilities allegedly used to manipulate online conversations ahead of the 2027 general elections.
## What the police said

Speaking on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, at a webinar on AI, misinformation and the 2027 elections, Assistant Commissioner of Police Bashir Abdullahi, who represented the Inspector-General of Police, said officers had carried out targeted raids on so-called phone farms after receiving information about a coordinated effort to interfere with the polls. He explained that a single operator can use hundreds of phones and automated accounts to push the same message, creating the impression that many people are independently discussing an issue. He said the raids had disrupted the operation.
## Suspect arrested

Abdullahi said a suspect was in custody after officers traced allegedly false reports about a candidate from the South-South. He said the reports were allegedly meant to discredit the candidate and influence voters. The suspect has not been named or charged in court.
## Free speech

He said the police would prosecute people found to have spread false information capable of undermining the elections, but stressed that enforcement would be guided by the law and that the force would not interfere with legitimate public debate. He also said the police had acquired tools that can detect deepfake videos, altered photos and cloned voices.
## Background
At the same event, INEC said its own staff in about 10 states had uploaded AI-generated photos to the voters' register. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Police say phone farms were raided.
A suspect is in custody over false reports.
Police say lawful debate will not be targeted.

stories.h: Ayra Starr confirmed for Coachella 2027 on SZA-headlined Sunday
stories.p: Ayra Starr will perform at the 2027 Coachella festival in California, appearing on the Sunday bill of both weekends, which SZA headlines. The singer told fans: 'See you in the desert.'
body: Afrobeats star Ayra Starr has been announced as one of the performers at the 2027 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
## The line-up

The festival's organisers revealed the line-up on Instagram on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. Ayra Starr is on the Sunday bill for both weekends and is expected to perform on 11 and 18 April 2027. The Sunday shows are headlined by American R&B star SZA, with Don Toliver, Kygo, Jorja Smith, Victoria Monét and Tove Lo among the other acts. Dua Lipa is among the festival's other headliners. Coachella takes place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, from 9 to 11 April and 16 to 18 April.
## Her reaction
The singer shared the news on her own Instagram page with a short message telling fans she would see them in the desert.
## Background

Ayra Starr, signed to Mavin Records, rose to international fame with hits such as 'Rush' and has become one of the most successful young Nigerian artists of her generation. Coachella is one of the world's biggest music festivals.
more: She will play on 11 and 18 April 2027.
SZA headlines the Sunday shows.
She told fans: 'See you in the desert.'

stories.h: Usher and Chris Brown's Los Angeles concert reportedly cancelled amid feud
stories.p: Usher and Chris Brown's 16 November show at SoFi Stadium has reportedly been marked as cancelled on Ticketmaster, with fans told they will be refunded. It is unclear whether it is linked to the singers' backstage row in Atlanta.
body: A Los Angeles concert by R&B stars Usher and Chris Brown has reportedly been cancelled.
## What happened

According to reports on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the pair's 16 November show at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, was marked as cancelled on Ticketmaster, and ticket holders were told they would receive refunds. No reason was given. Their 15 November show at the same venue, and their remaining Atlanta dates, were still listed as going ahead.
## The feud

It is not clear whether the cancellation is linked to the reported argument between the two singers before their Atlanta concert last week. Usher reportedly wanted to start that show on time, while Brown wanted to wait for fans stuck in traffic, and the disagreement was said to have delayed the performance by almost three hours. Sources quoted in reports say the two have still not met to settle their differences and describe the relationship as frosty.
## Background
The two stars are on a joint tour. Neither singer had publicly commented on the cancellation at the time of writing.
more: The 16 November SoFi show was marked cancelled.
Fans are reportedly being refunded.
The 15 November show is still on.

stories.h: Prison Break and Mike Hammer actor Stacy Keach dies at 85
stories.p: American actor Stacy Keach, known for playing detective Mike Hammer and for his role in Prison Break, has died at 85 after a long battle with heart disease, his wife said.
body: American actor Stacy Keach has died at the age of 85.
## What happened

Keach reportedly died on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, at his home in Poland after a long battle with a serious heart condition and heart failure. His wife, Małgosia Tomassi Keach, announced his death and described him as a brave man who stayed strong despite his health problems.
## His career

Keach began acting on Broadway in the 1960s before moving into films in the following decade, and drew attention starring alongside Faye Dunaway in the 1971 film 'Doc'. He became best known for playing private investigator Mike Hammer in the television series 'Mickey Spillane's Mike Hammer' and 'The New Mike Hammer'. Younger audiences knew him as the prison warden in the hit series 'Prison Break'.
more: Keach died at his home in Poland.
He was best known as detective Mike Hammer.
He also starred in Prison Break.

stories.h: INEC says its staff in about 10 states uploaded AI photos to voters' register
stories.p: INEC says it has identified its own officials in about 10 states who uploaded AI-generated photographs to the voters' register. The images have been removed and the commission says the staff involved will face disciplinary action.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) says it has identified officials in about 10 states who uploaded photographs generated by artificial intelligence to Nigeria's voters' register.
## What INEC said

Speaking on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, at a webinar on AI, misinformation and the 2027 elections, INEC National Commissioner Mohammed Haruna, who chairs the commission's Information and Voter Education Committee, said a large number of AI-generated pictures had been posted onto the register and had since been taken down. He said the commission had the names of the staff involved across about 10 states and would take disciplinary action against them.
## Limits on what INEC can do

Haruna said it could be difficult for the commission to stop members of the public from digitally altering their own photographs before submitting them, but that INEC could act directly where its own staff were responsible.
## Background

The issue of AI-generated images on the register had already drawn public attention, raising concerns about the accuracy of the voter roll ahead of the general elections. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: INEC has named staff in about 10 states.
The AI photos have been removed.
Disciplinary action is planned.
stories.alt: A man in a white agbada and patterned cap seated in an office chair

stories.h: Tinubu rewards each Flamingos player with ₦100m after U-17 World Cup win
stories.p: President Tinubu has rewarded each Flamingos player with a ₦100 million savings certificate, held in trust until they turn 18, after their FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup win. The head coach gets ₦100 million and each technical official ₦50 million. First Lady Remi Tinubu announced the rewards at the Villa.
body: The Flamingos, Nigeria's under-17 women's football team, have been welcomed at the Presidential Villa in Abuja after winning the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
## The reception

First Lady Oluremi Tinubu received the players and officials on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, on behalf of President Bola Tinubu, in what was described as a celebratory homecoming visit and the federal government's formal recognition of the team's achievement.
## ₦100 million each

During the visit, the First Lady announced that the President was giving each player a ₦100 million savings certificate. The money will be held in trust in designated bank accounts until each player turns 18, so the teenage champions will not have immediate access to it. The reward was extended to the coaching staff: the head coach will receive ₦100 million in cash and each member of the technical crew ₦50 million.
## The win

The Flamingos beat Japan 2–1 in the final in Morocco on Saturday, 7 November, with goals from Awawu Bashiru and Oluebube Umejiaku, becoming the first African side to win the tournament. After losing their opening game to Poland, they won five matches in a row, including victories over defending champions North Korea, Mexico, Venezuela and Brazil. The win means Nigeria has now won the FIFA U-17 World Cup in both the men's and women's competitions.
## Rewards

The Senate has also pledged ₦100 million to the team, and the players had earlier received $50,000 in cash. FIFA does not award prize money at this level, so rewards depend on governments and sponsors.
more: Each player gets a ₦100m savings certificate.
The money is held in trust until they turn 18.
The head coach gets ₦100m; officials ₦50m each.

stories.h: Uzodimma insists he will keep Imo West Senate ticket despite court ruling
stories.p: Imo governor Hope Uzodimma says he will not give up the APC ticket for Imo West senatorial district, despite a Federal High Court ruling that named his predecessor Rochas Okorocha as the party's candidate.
body: Imo State governor Hope Uzodimma has vowed to continue his bid for the Imo West Senate seat, despite a court judgment that removed him as the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate.
## What he said

Speaking after Mass at the Government House chapel in Owerri, reported on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Uzodimma dismissed suggestions that he would surrender the ticket, telling supporters that anyone who says someone else will take it from him is lying. He urged residents to campaign for APC candidates in state and federal races, naming the party's candidates for the Okigwe and Owerri zones, and continued to present himself as the party's candidate for Orlu, the Imo West zone.
## The court ruling

A Federal High Court recently ruled that former governor Rochas Okorocha, not Uzodimma, is the APC's rightful candidate for Imo West. Okorocha, who represented the district in the Senate from 2019 to 2023, was congratulated on the ruling by former APC chairman Abdullahi Ganduje.
## Background

Uzodimma, who is serving his second term as governor and cannot run again, is a key ally of President Bola Tinubu in the South-East. FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has denied having any role in the judgment.
more: Uzodimma says he will keep the ticket.
A court named Okorocha as the APC candidate.
Uzodimma is in his second and final term.

stories.h: Owerri event centre that hosted Obi town hall marked by Imo government
stories.p: An event centre in Owerri that hosted a Nigeria Democratic Congress town hall meeting with Peter Obi has reportedly been marked by the Imo State government, which demanded its title documents within 48 hours. Some Nigerians link the move to the event; others say the owners should simply produce the papers.
body: An event centre in Owerri, Imo State, has reportedly been marked by the state government days after hosting a town hall meeting of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC).
## What happened

Photos shared online on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, show a message sprayed in red paint on the property, attributed to the Imo State government, asking the owners to show their title document and ground rent receipts within 48 hours. The venue, on Port Harcourt Road in New Owerri, hosted a town hall meeting with Peter Obi, the NDC presidential candidate, and his allies on 31 October.
## How people reacted

Some social media users questioned whether the venue was being punished for hosting an opposition event, while others said the owners should simply present the requested documents and urged critics not to politicise the matter. The state government had not publicly explained the reason for the notice at the time of writing.
## Background
Imo is governed by Hope Uzodimma of the All Progressives Congress (APC), a strong supporter of President Bola Tinubu's re-election. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: The notice asks for title documents within 48 hours.
The venue hosted an Obi town hall on 31 October.
Reactions online are divided.

stories.h: Olamide announces YBNL reunion concert with Adekunle Gold, Fireboy and Lil Kesh
stories.p: Olamide is bringing past and present YBNL stars, including Adekunle Gold, Fireboy DML, Lil Kesh, Young Jonn and Pheelz, together for a reunion show in Lagos on 18 December.
body: Rapper and record label boss Olamide has announced a reunion concert featuring some of the biggest names to come through his label, YBNL.
## The line-up

In an Instagram video on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Olamide said the show will take place in Lagos on 18 December as part of a December festival. The line-up includes Adekunle Gold, Lil Kesh, Fireboy DML and Young Jonn, as well as producer Pheelz and DJ Enimoney.
## Why it matters

The artists represent different eras of the label. Adekunle Gold and Lil Kesh rose to fame in YBNL's early years, while Fireboy DML and Young Jonn became key names later on. Pheelz produced many of the label's hits and helped shape its sound.
## Background

Olamide founded YBNL in 2012 and has helped launch several successful careers. He recently announced a headline show at London's 20,000-capacity O2 Arena on 25 March 2027, and released a new single in October.
more: The show is on 18 December in Lagos.
Adekunle Gold, Fireboy and Lil Kesh are on the bill.
Olamide also plans an O2 Arena show in March.

stories.h: Pochettino reportedly close to deal to become Manchester United coach
stories.p: Manchester United are reportedly close to agreeing a deal with Mauricio Pochettino to become their next head coach if they decide to sack Michael Carrick.
body: Manchester United are reportedly close to agreeing terms with Mauricio Pochettino to take charge of the club.
## What is reported

According to reports on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the deal would only go ahead if United decide to sack their current head coach, Michael Carrick. No decision has been publicly announced, and the club has not commented.
## Talks with US Soccer

According to further reports on Thursday, 12 November, United have contacted US Soccer about triggering a reported $10 million release clause in Pochettino's contract, and expect to spend about $2 million more to bring in his backroom staff. Senior executives reportedly met minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe in Monaco on Wednesday and scheduled a formal meeting with Carrick for Thursday, after which he is widely expected to leave. United are 18th in the Premier League with just one league win this season.
## Who is Pochettino
The Argentine has previously managed Tottenham Hotspur, Paris Saint-Germain and Chelsea, and was appointed head coach of the United States men's national team in September 2024.
## Background

Carrick has come under growing pressure after a run of poor results, and senior figures at the club are reported to have met to discuss his future. Several candidates have been linked with the job in recent days.
more: The move depends on United sacking Carrick.
Pochettino has managed Spurs, PSG and Chelsea.
The club has not commented.

stories.h: Salvadoran troops reportedly launch deadly operation against Haitian gang, leaving 20 dead
stories.p: At least 20 people have reportedly been killed in an operation involving troops from El Salvador against suspected gang members in Haiti, where armed groups have taken control of large areas and forced thousands from their homes.
body: At least 20 people have reportedly been killed in an operation involving Salvadoran troops targeting suspected gang members in Haiti.
## A country held hostage

The reported incident comes as Haiti continues to struggle with widespread gang violence, kidnappings and insecurity, particularly in areas where armed groups have taken control of communities and forced thousands of residents to flee.
For years, ordinary Haitians have lived under the constant threat of armed gangs, with many families unable to go about their daily lives without fear.
## Foreign forces on the ground
Soldiers from El Salvador have been in Haiti since early 2025 as part of an internationally backed mission to help the Haitian police fight the gangs, alongside forces from other countries.
The reported operation has raised fresh questions about the growing role of foreign security forces in efforts to restore order in the troubled Caribbean nation.
## What we don't know
The circumstances of the reported deaths, including the identities of those killed and the exact role played by the Salvadoran troops, have not been independently confirmed.
## Over to you
Can foreign military intervention finally help Haiti regain control from armed gangs, or will it only lead to more bloodshed?
more: At least 20 people were reportedly killed.
Salvadoran troops are part of a mission to fight Haiti's gangs.
The details have not been independently confirmed.

stories.h: Tinubu launches ₦52,500 minimum monthly pension for 173,209 retirees
stories.p: President Tinubu has activated a guaranteed minimum pension of ₦52,500 a month for 173,209 retirees under the Contributory Pension Scheme, a provision that has been in law since 2004 but was never enforced. He also launched free basic healthcare for low-income pensioners.
body: Retirees under Nigeria's Contributory Pension Scheme will now receive at least ₦52,500 a month, after President Bola Tinubu activated a minimum pension guarantee in Abuja.
## What was announced

At the Presidential Pension Security Initiatives ceremony at the State House on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the President, represented by Senate President Godswill Akpabio, declared the guarantee active for 173,209 qualifying retirees. He described it as a floor beneath Nigerian retirees and urged future governments to raise it but never remove it. The Director-General of the National Pension Commission (PenCom), Omolola Oloworaran, confirmed the figure and said more than 65 per cent of private-sector retirees currently earn less than the new minimum.
## Who benefits

According to PenCom, 54 per cent of the qualifying retirees come from the private sector, 34 per cent from federal service and 12 per cent from state employment. More than ₦400bn in the Pension Protection Fund will finance the guarantee.
## Healthcare and arrears

The President also launched PenCare, a healthcare plan that will give low-income pensioners free access to essential health services, with access cards to be distributed in the coming months. He said the government had issued a ₦758bn bond to clear pension arrears and approved a ₦32,000 monthly adjustment for affected federal pensioners.
## Background
The minimum pension was first written into the Pension Reform Act of 2004 and kept in the 2014 law, but no government had put it into effect until now.
more: 173,209 retirees qualify for the ₦52,500 minimum.
Free healthcare for low-income pensioners was also launched.
A ₦758bn bond will clear pension arrears.

stories.h: Police open probe after video shows officers escorting Blord
stories.p: The Nigeria Police Force says it has opened an investigation after a video showed police officers escorting businessman and influencer Blord, describing the arrangement as unlawful. Some social media users have defended him.
body: The Nigeria Police Force has launched an investigation into officers seen in a video providing an escort for businessman and social media personality Linus Williams, popularly known as Blord.
## What the police said

In a post on X on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the Force Public Relations Officer described the situation as unlawful and illegal, added the hashtag #NoToImpunity, and confirmed that a probe had begun. The statement did not make clear exactly which part of the incident is being investigated.
## Background

The video drew attention after social media users pointed out that Blord had recently been seen in caps associated with Rabiu Kwankwaso, running mate to Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), fuelling speculation about his political leanings. Blord was recently released from detention and publicly thanked activist Omoyele Sowore, now a presidential candidate himself, for his intervention. In late 2025, President Bola Tinubu ordered the withdrawal of police officers attached to VIPs.
## How people reacted
The police announcement drew strong reactions online, with some users defending Blord. Blord had not publicly responded at the time of writing.
more: Police called the escort arrangement unlawful.
An investigation has begun.
Blord has not yet responded.

stories.h: Dangote refinery reportedly cuts petrol price to ₦1,250 and drops fixed pricing
stories.p: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has reportedly cut its petrol loading price to ₦1,250 per litre, down ₦50, after returning to a pricing system linked to international gasoline prices. That means pump prices could now rise or fall with global markets.
body: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has reportedly reduced its petrol loading price to ₦1,250 per litre and changed how it sets prices.
## What changed

According to industry sources cited in reports on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the new arrangement took effect on Saturday, 7 November. The refinery is said to have abandoned its fixed gantry price of ₦1,300 per litre and returned to pricing petrol against an international gasoline benchmark. The new price is about ₦50, or roughly 3.85 per cent, lower.
## What it means

Under the benchmark-linked system, the refinery's petrol prices can move up or down with global gasoline prices, rather than staying fixed. Diesel is reportedly still sold at a fixed gantry price. The refinery is also said to have restructured the group of marketers that distribute its products.
## Background

The change comes amid growing competition in Nigeria's fuel market between the refinery, importers and depot owners, with prices shifting frequently in recent weeks. How much of the cut reaches motorists at filling stations will depend on marketers.
more: The loading price is reportedly ₦1,250 per litre.
Prices will now track global gasoline prices.
Diesel pricing is said to be unchanged.

stories.h: Adamawa governor Fintiri denies threatening to detain 'Bamayi' chanters
stories.p: Adamawa governor Ahmadu Fintiri's media team says a report claiming he threatened to detain anyone who shouts 'Bamayi' until after the 2027 elections is false, and has demanded a retraction from the online blog that published it.
body: The media office of Adamawa State governor Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri has rejected a report that the governor threatened to detain people who shout the slogan 'Bamayi'.
## The claim

A report circulating on social media alleged that Fintiri had said anyone chanting 'Bamayi', a Hausa political slogan, would be detained until after the 2027 general elections. In a statement reported on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the governor's aide on electronic media said Fintiri never made such a statement, publicly or privately, and described the report as fabricated and a deliberate misrepresentation of his position.
## Demand for retraction

The statement named a Hausa-language online blog based in Jigawa State as the source and asked it to withdraw the report and apologise, or produce evidence to support it. It warned that legal action could follow if it did neither. The governor's team said the report was designed to stoke political tension and damage his reputation ahead of the elections.
## Background

Fintiri has governed Adamawa since 2019 and is in his second term. Political tension has been rising across the country ahead of the 2027 general elections, with false reports and misinformation becoming a growing concern for parties and candidates on all sides.
more: Fintiri's team says the report is false.
It demanded a retraction and an apology.
Legal action has been threatened.

stories.h: BBNaija's Faith builds filter game for Funke Akindele's new film The Four
stories.p: Reality star Dr Faith Adewale has created a Snapchat filter game inspired by Funke Akindele's upcoming film The Four, complete with a ticket-booking button. Funke Akindele reacted warmly to the fan-made promotion.
body: Big Brother Naija star Dr Faith Adewale has won praise online after creating a game to promote Funke Akindele's upcoming film, The Four.
## The game

In a video shared on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Faith showed how the Snapchat filter works. Players are paired with three of their real friends and must complete quick physical challenges, such as tapping the screen rapidly or raising their eyebrows, to 'rescue' each one. When all three are saved, the group of four is reunited, echoing the theme of the film. Faith set a time of 15.4 seconds and challenged her followers to beat it. The filter also includes a button that links to a cinema website where users can buy tickets.
## Funke reacts
Funke Akindele, who directs and stars in the film, spotted the post and responded with delight, and the cinema chain also celebrated the idea online.
## Background

The Four is due in Nigerian cinemas on 11 December 2026, in time for the festive season. Funke Akindele is one of Nollywood's most commercially successful filmmakers, with several of her previous December releases breaking box office records.

stories.h: Ebola: 28 contacts still under watch in Nigeria, 34 cleared, says NCDC
stories.p: The NCDC says 28 people linked to Nigeria's single imported case of Bundibugyo virus disease, a type of Ebola, remain under surveillance, while 34 others have been cleared after 21 days of monitoring. No further cases have been confirmed.
body: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) says 28 people linked to the country's imported Ebola case are still being monitored.
## The update

In its national health security update released on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, NCDC Director-General Dr Jide Idris said 34 other contacts had been discharged after completing the mandatory 21-day monitoring period. As of 9 November, Nigeria had confirmed only one imported case of Bundibugyo virus disease, a species of Ebola, with no further confirmed cases.
## The response

Idris said the response involves the Federal Ministry of Health, the FCT Administration, state authorities and development partners, with contact tracing, investigation of reported cases, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, safe patient care and stronger screening at entry points.
## Background

Ebola is a severe and often deadly viral disease spread through contact with the body fluids of infected people. The 21-day monitoring period reflects the maximum incubation time of the virus. The case in Nigeria is linked to an outbreak in Central Africa; the United States has just barred travellers who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the past 21 days. Nigeria contained an Ebola outbreak in 2014.
## Advice

Health authorities urge anyone with symptoms such as fever, weakness, vomiting or unexplained bleeding, especially after travel or contact with a suspected case, to report to a health facility immediately.

stories.h: Donald Duke says he will step down if opposition agrees on single candidate
stories.p: PRP presidential candidate Donald Duke says he is willing to step aside for a stronger opposition candidate, such as Atiku Abubakar or Peter Obi, if opposition parties agree through a credible process on who should face President Tinubu.
body: Donald Duke, the presidential candidate of the Peoples Redemption Party (PRP), says he is ready to step aside for a stronger opposition candidate in the 2027 election.
## What he said

Speaking in Abuja on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, at the unveiling of his running mate, Malam Sule Mohammed, and the launch of the PRP's manifesto, the former Cross River governor said he would respect any democratic decision by opposition parties to rally behind one candidate to challenge President Bola Tinubu, whether Atiku Abubakar of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) or Peter Obi of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), as long as the choice came through a credible collective process. He said a genuine coalition could not simply gather around a name, and needed a shared agenda.
## Background

Duke governed Cross River State from 1999 to 2007 and is known for developing the Obudu Ranch Resort and the Tinapa project. He was a presidential candidate in 2023. There are 18 presidential candidates for the 16 January 2027 election. Talks about a single opposition candidate have repeatedly stalled, with Atiku and Obi both insisting on running.
more: Duke is the PRP presidential candidate.

stories.h: Edo governor Okpebholo vows to sign death warrants for convicted kidnappers, 'even my father'
stories.p: Edo governor Monday Okpebholo says he will sign the death warrants of anyone convicted of kidnapping under the state's law, even if it were his own father, as his government moves to enforce the death penalty for the crime.
body: Edo State governor Monday Okpebholo says he will approve the execution of convicted kidnappers, regardless of who they are.
## What he said

In a video shared on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, the governor said he would sign death warrants for anyone found guilty of kidnapping, even if it were his own father or a close relative. He said the state needed to remove criminal elements from society, arguing that kidnappers were the ones killing people.
## The law

Edo State has a law that prescribes the death penalty for kidnapping, and the governor's administration says it is moving to enforce it. Under Nigerian law, state governors must sign death warrants before executions can take place.
## Background
Executions in Nigeria are rare because governors have generally been reluctant to sign death warrants, and human rights groups oppose the death penalty.

stories.h: Bobrisky hits back at TBoss over criticism of men in feminine fashion
stories.p: Bobrisky has responded to reality star TBoss, who criticised Nigerian men adopting feminine dressing styles at Lagos fashion events, saying nobody has the right to dictate how adults dress.
body: Socialite Bobrisky has publicly responded to Big Brother Naija alumna TBoss over her comments about men who dress in feminine styles.
## How it started

TBoss, whose real name is Tokunbo Idowu, had expressed disapproval of what she described as a growing trend of Nigerian men adopting feminine styles, following outfits seen at GTCO Fashion Week in Lagos, saying 'we're slowly losing our men'. Her remarks sparked debate, with influencer Izzy Ogbeide and model Onyx Godwin among those who disagreed.
## Bobrisky's response

In a series of Instagram posts on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Bobrisky said they held TBoss in some regard but found her comments out of line, insisting that nobody has the right to tell another adult how to dress or express themselves. Bobrisky drew a distinction between sharing a personal opinion and trying to impose it on others.
## TBoss responds

TBoss later responded to the backlash on social media, saying her comment was never about anyone's sexual preference or what people do in private, but only about what was being shown in public. She complained that people could no longer share a different opinion without being insulted, and criticised commentator Lizzy Ogbeide for bringing up her upbringing. Skit maker Steve Chuks was also among those who criticised her original remarks.
## Background

Bobrisky now lives abroad. Content creator Enioluwa also defended the men's outfits at the fashion week, saying it was a fashion show and nobody was losing anything. TBoss had not responded at the time of writing.

stories.p: Blessing CEO says she expected VeryDarkMan to attack her during her difficult period, given their history of clashes. Instead, she says, he offered to help her rebuild her life, and she has now declared herself a member of the Ratel Movement.

stories.p: Businessman Blord has sparked talk after being seen in Kano wearing a cap with a slogan associated with Rabiu Kwankwaso, months after he declared support for Omoyele Sowore's movement.

During a visit to Kano State, reported on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Blord was seen wearing a cap with the words 'Nigeria Must Be OK', a slogan associated with Kwankwaso, the NDC's vice-presidential candidate on Peter Obi's ticket. Many social media users took it as a possible sign of support for the Obi–Kwankwaso campaign.
## 'Nigeria Must Be OK' caption

Blord later shared a photo of himself in the cap with a caption praising Kano and ending with the phrase 'Nigeria Must Be OK', associated with the Obi–Kwankwaso campaign, further fuelling speculation that he has shifted his support from Sowore, who is running for president on a different platform.

The appearance drew attention because Blord had earlier declared support for activist Omoyele Sowore after Sowore was released from Kuje Prison in April 2026. At the time, Blord praised Sowore for intervening in his own legal case, described himself as a member of the Revolution Now movement and was presented with a branded beret. stories.h: Jigawa declares holiday as Tinubu visits for rally and project launches
stories.p: Jigawa State declared Tuesday a public holiday for President Tinubu's first official visit since 2023. He is due to hold an APC rally and commission projects including an agricultural mechanisation programme with 400 tractors.
body: Jigawa State has declared Tuesday, 10 November 2026, a public holiday for a visit by President Bola Tinubu.
## The visit

Governor Umar Namadi told journalists in Dutse on Monday that the President would hold an All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally and inaugurate four projects. He said it would be Tinubu's first official visit to the state since he took office in May 2023. The projects include a technical services centre, a skills acquisition centre named after the President, an agricultural mechanisation programme and a dualised road in Dutse.
## The farm equipment
The agricultural package includes 400 tractors, 60 combine harvesters, 150 boom sprayers and 150 seeders, along with other equipment intended to boost farm output in the state.
## Power pledge at the rally

At the APC rally in Jigawa, Tinubu promised to lower the cost of living and provide reliable electricity, saying the old privatisation model was not working. During his 2023 campaign he said Nigerians should not re-elect him if he failed to provide stable power in his first term.
## Background

The Jigawa visit continues the President's campaign tour, which in the past week has taken him to Akwa Ibom, Rivers and Ebonyi states. Namadi, elected on the APC platform in 2023, is a strong supporter of the President's re-election. The North-West, which includes Jigawa, has one of the largest voting populations in Nigeria.

stories.h: Victor Umeh: Any Igbo person against Peter Obi is an enemy of the Igbo
stories.p: Senator Victor Umeh of the NDC has said any Igbo person who campaigns against Peter Obi's presidential bid is an enemy of the Igbo people, and urged the South-East to unite behind him. He also cautioned the Anambra government.
body: Senator Victor Umeh, who represents Anambra Central, has warned that any Igbo person working against Peter Obi's presidential ambition is an enemy of the Igbo people.
## What he said

In a video that circulated on Monday, 9 November 2026, Umeh, a member of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), described Obi as the conscience of the Igbo people in the 2027 election and urged South-East residents to unite behind his bid. He cautioned political leaders in the region, particularly the Anambra State Government, against actions that could undermine Obi's campaign.
## Background

Obi, a former Anambra governor, is the NDC's presidential candidate, with Rabiu Kwankwaso as his running mate. While he remains popular in the South-East, several of the region's governors have declared support for President Bola Tinubu. Anambra Governor Charles Soludo's APGA last week adopted Tinubu as its candidate and promised him half of the state's votes, while Ebonyi Governor Francis Nwifuru on Monday promised Tinubu 80 per cent of Ebonyi's votes. The NDC in Anambra has set a target of 98 per cent of the state's votes for Obi.
## Reactions
The Anambra government had not publicly responded at the time of writing.
## Yul Edochie responds

Actor Yul Edochie, a supporter of President Tinubu, challenged Umeh in a video on 10 November, saying he respected the senator but that such remarks could make Igbo people see one another as enemies. He said political choice is a personal right, and noted that Tinubu and Seyi Makinde are both from the South-West, yet no Yoruba leader has called supporters of either man enemies of the region.
## What happens next
The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
